name: stats-bold
title: Bold Stats Display
description: A full-width stats section pairing an oversized 10B+ API-calls figure and a bright gradient image with three smaller metrics below: latency, regions and support hours. Numbers count up as it scrolls into view.
use: A marketing page needs a compact proof section of large numbers, one hero metric and three supporting ones.
avoid: All copy and the photo are hardcoded, and the section insists on min-h-screen, so it cannot sit in a short page.
a11y: The photo's alt text is the vague phrase 'supportive img', and the count-up has no reduced-motion guard. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: On black, a very large pale 10B+ sits at the left, followed by a small bold title and a two-line grey caption, with a wide pink-to-white gradient photo at right. A thin rule divides it from a row of three numbers, each with a tiny uppercase label.
behaves: When the section enters view, 10B+, 0.1ms and 142 tick up from zero over about a second, and the lower row slides up and fades in. The 24/7 figure is static text. Nothing reacts to the pointer.
customise: Takes no props. The figures, copy, labels, image URL and full-screen-height layout all live in the file, so any change is a source edit.
weight: light: A few spans count up once on view; no continuous loop or canvas.
